title: Massive area of device storage?
content: It's hard to describe but I went to a mall like world last night that had a massive (think like multiple walls as high as you can see) of wall to wall device storage.They were identical black boxes. I thought it was apartments, but when I got closer realized it was just millions of little black boxes. They were thin like a game system. I accidentally pushed a button on one and it came out like I could take it, but I got scared because I thought it would notify the owner that the button was pushed so I pushed it back in and quickly walked away. Behind that area was an arcade area. There were a lot of different games but the ones that stood out to me was one that had a large circle like you could wakk through and another that you laid down and closed a lid over your body. It was supposed to be super emersive, it had a green sticky area where the head goes. I didn't play any games, I was waiting for someone that was on the phone.
